provenance.temperature_K: Supplementary Figs S5-S7: hyperspectral PL map of tent A measured at T = 3.5 K
provenance.instrument_resolution_meV: Methods: Isoplane SCT-320, 150 g/mm grating, spectral resolution ~3.25 meV (600 g/mm ~300 ueV, 2400 g/mm ~30 ueV)
provenance.strain_shift_halfrange_nm: Supplementary Fig. S6 (per-pixel peak wavelengths of the ten NMF lines over the 11x11 tent-A map): the dominant 694 nm line spans 694.6-696.2 nm (1.6 nm); weaker lines span 3-7 nm (partly noise). Half-range ~1-3 nm; 3.0 nm used as the per-line centre window. Main text: 'no spectral wandering' in PL.
provenance.optical_phonon_max_meV: Upper bound for a one-phonon optical replica offset. GaSe's highest Raman-active optical mode is ~308 cm^-1 (~38 meV; literature value, to be confirmed by the user); rounded up to 40 meV. On the tent map the 695 nm emitter's optical-phonon replica sits 31-32 meV below it (user-confirmed from the map: present only with the line, constant offset, follows its strain shift, same width).
